title: Our Family Game Never ENDED 🫣
description:
Thirty-one years ago my whole family played hide-and-seek at Grandma's house. Everyone was found by dinner except Uncle Pete. Grandma says the game isn't over until everyone's found.

So every reunion, we still look for him.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment FOUND if you spotted him first.
